scope: Single seed1000-update precision-only trial, same input bytes and FP32 endpoint inference. High-noise/shadow/GFX changes are visually subtle; no large weak-detail or real-mesh recovery. Separate faint-ADC panel has small consistent selected-stratum gains and slightly lower global PSNR. No full427photo/all-camera FP32 result or universal precision conclusion. V120 remains general recommendation; do not discard documented gains via a promotion gate.
